messages:
maria: FYI: vendor import mismatch pushed wrong segment tag -> playbook 'auto-reach' targeted renewals and sent onboarding nudges. Saw ~6.4k touches in 30m. Can we stop new sends and isolate the cohort?

ops-bot: playbook-runner: auto-reach run id ar-20260322-04 started 2026-03-22T04:05:12Z. total_recipients: 6402, phase: send_emails (inflight).

derek: Pause rule: Admin > Playbooks > auto-reach > Pause. I'll put a kill switch on the worker. Also need suppression CSV and a quick health filter to exclude renewals <45d.

sophie: How many of those are high-risk renewals? We need to route enablement + AE outreach, not mass nudges.

maria: Quick counts: ~420 renewals within 60d, ~230 classified as high-risk by risk_score>0.7. Query: `SELECT id, renew_date, risk_score FROM crm.accounts WHERE tag like '%import:vendor23%' LIMIT 5000;`

jamal: I'm generating suppression list now. Will exclude: `trial=true`, `renewal_days <=45` AND `risk_score >= 0.7` flagged for AE handoff. Uploading to s3://cs-ops/suppressions/ar-20260322-suppress.csv in 2m.

derek: Settings change proposal: default playbook behavior for new import cohorts -> run dry-run, require `cohort_size < 1000` or explicit manager approval, and auto-exclude renewals<60d. Add a fast fail when more than 5% are flagged high-risk.

sophie: Also we need a short enablement thread to coordinate outreach: AEs + Onboarding to call the 230 high-risk accounts. I'll create a shared sheet and tag owners.

maria: Customer-facing copy: "We apologize for the confusion; you may have received an automated onboarding message in error. If it affected your renewal experience, please let us know [link]." Keep it separate from AE outreach.

ops-bot: playbook-runner: ar-20260322-04 paused by derek at 2026-03-22T04:17:04Z. recipients_sent: 3,212.

jamal: Suppression uploaded and shared. Dry-run of owner-normalize started: `python cs_tools/owner_normalize.py --cohort vendor23-import --dry-run --limit 250`. Posting sample CSV in thread.

derek: After triage: immediate actions = pause playbook, suppress cohort, AE handoff for high-risk renewals, send apology to trials only, run owner-normalize dry-run then gated apply. Longer-term: add import validation tests, schema checks, and a pre-flight playbook dry-run.

sophie: I'll DM Product to block further vendor imports until we have presubmit checks. Also scheduling a 20-min war room in 10 to assign owners.

maria: Note for postmortem: include timeline, sample logs (delivery ids), amount of sent nudges, and customer outreach list. We'll need a retro with Product + Integrations + CS.

jamal: Dry-run results: owner_normalize identified 1,800 accounts with likely owner candidates; 1,120 exact email matches, 680 fuzzy matches. Will include confidence scores in CSV.

derek: Good — let's only auto-claim exact matches (confidence >= 0.98) during the gated backfill. Rest go to manual review queue in the admin app.

maria: Thanks team. Quick note: update playbook template to default `dry_run=true` and add `preflight_checks` checkbox for imports. We'll document in the CS runbook and notify support to expect bump in tickets.

ops-bot: note: incident created #INC-20260322-AR by maria.

sophie: Appreciate the quick responses. See you at the war room.
